project_name: Rudaya Power Pvt. Ltd. Finance Tracker
vibe: Industrial Precision, Data-Dense, Authoritative, Minimalist ERP

typography.instructions: Use Outfit for all Dashboard titles and card headers. Use IBM Plex Sans for general UI text. CRITICAL: Use JetBrains Mono for all financial figures, table cells with numbers, and dates to ensure tabular alignment. Implement tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight`) on large headers. Avoid generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.

colors.instructions: Strict monochrome dominance. 95% of the UI should be black, white, and grays. Use color strictly as a function (Green for Revenue/Profit, Red for Expenses/Costs). The `industrial_accent` (Yellow) should be used minimally, perhaps as an active state indicator on the sidebar or a subtle focus ring. DO NOT use generic purple, teal-green, or soft gradients. Never use purely transparent overlays.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (`border-gray-200`). Avoid soft drop shadows; if elevation is needed, use a hard 2px offset shadow or rely entirely on border contrast.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Use sharp edges or very subtle rounding (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Avoid pill shapes for standard cards to maintain the structural ERP look.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift contrast boldly. e.g., Hovering a table row changes it to `bg-gray-50`. Hovering a primary button shifts from `bg-gray-900` to `bg-gray-700`.

layouts_and_grids.page_layout: Sidebar navigation (left) with a rigid 1px right border. Main content area (right) with a sticky top header.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Top row: 5 KPI cards (`grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5`). Below: Main chart spanning full width or `col-span-3`, adjacent to a dense recent transactions list.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous container spacing (`p-6` or `p-8`). Dense internal data spacing (`py-2`, `px-3` in tables) for maximum information density without feeling cramped.
layouts_and_grids.forms: Use right-side inspector drawers (Slide-overs) for the 'Add Transaction' dialog instead of standard center modals to keep the data table visible in the background.

component_guidelines.tables: Must use Shadcn Table. Include a sticky header. Right-align all currency columns. Apply alternating row backgrounds or sharp bottom borders. Format numbers to South Asian (Indian) standard (e.g., ₹ 1,50,000.00).
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn charts). Use crisp 2px stroke line charts or sharp bar charts. Disable filled area gradients to maintain the 'Swiss' objective look.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-sm`). High contrast. Primary buttons are deep black with white text.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_selects: Shadcn components (`Input`, `Select`, `Popover` + `Command` for combobox). Use `border-gray-300` and sharp corners. On focus, use a solid 2px ring of `ring-gray-900`.

icons.style: Use 'regular' weight for clear, professional iconography. Do not use emojis.

login_background.description: Yellow and black industrial factory. Use this as a full-bleed background for the Login/Register screen.
login_background.usage: Overlay with a 50% black/dark gray solid or deeply saturated glassmorphism pane to ensure the login form is perfectly readable. Do NOT use this image on data dashboard screens.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Financial numbers in green/red MUST be dark enough to read on white backgrounds (e.g., use Emerald 600 and Red 600, not light pastel variants).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='kpi-total-revenue'`). Use kebab-case and role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts in index.html: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

Tailwind Config: Define custom fonts in tailwind.config.js theme (e.g., `fontFamily: { sans: ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'], heading: ['Outfit', 'sans-serif'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'] }`).
Add 'data-testid' to every button, link, form input, KPI card value, and chart container.
Implement the 'Project-wise P&L' as a matrix table (Projects on rows, metrics on columns: Revenue, Cost, Expense, Gross Profit, Net Profit) with a month filter.
The 'Add Transaction' form must use Shadcn components (Date Picker, Select for Type, Combobox for Account/Project) and should ideally appear in a Shadcn Sheet (drawer) to preserve table context.
Format all currency strings strictly with Indian Rupee symbol (₹) and Indian number formatting (`Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' })`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (no soft purples, no rounded-xl everything, no generic centered layouts).
Create depth through layout contrast and 1px borders, avoiding muddy shadow stacking.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not add `text-align: center` to the root App container.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) as icons. Rely solely on Phosphor Icons.
Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components from `src/components/ui/` before building custom ones.
If using a layout wrapper, ensure the sidebar navigates cleanly and the main view handles internal scrolling properly.
